colors.archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) adapted for Finance

positive_owed.usage: When a resident is owed money or has a credit balance.

negative_owes.usage: When a resident owes money for maintenance/water.

web_dashboard.alignment: Strict grid hierarchy. Left-align text, right-align monetary/meter values.

mobile_field_entry.inputs: Big number pads, 48px minimum height for inputs and buttons.
mobile_field_entry.camera_upload: Full width dropzone/button taking prominent screen real estate.

surfaces.cards: Flat Solid background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO heavy shadows, rounded-md (max 8px radius). Financial apps need solid grounding.
surfaces.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border for financial apps. Glassmorphism is discouraged for strict data apps.

components.tables: Dense, crisp. Use `tabular-nums` for all columns containing numbers. Highlight rows on hover with `hover:bg-slate-50`. Right-align numerical columns.
components.badges: Semantic only. Never rely on color alone. Always pair color with an icon (+/- or up/down arrows).
components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast. Hover state must increase contrast.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form primitives adapted for .js/.jsx. For mobile, use native number inputs optimized for numpad display.
components.tabs: Flat, cardless tab lists. Override Shadcn default `h-9` to `h-auto` to prevent cutoff.
components.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (best for dense dashboards, use Duotone or Regular weight).

motion.hover_states: Slight background color shifts (`bg-slate-50`), border color darkening.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., `transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease`). NO `transition: all`.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in for table rows or dashboard widgets.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Use Text Shadow over images if needed.
accessibility.color_blindness: Semantic colors (red/green) MUST be accompanied by icons or text labels (e.g., '+ ₹500' or '↓ ₹500').
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case based on role (e.g., `data-testid='submit-meter-reading-btn'`).
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings: `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:outline-none`.

media.images: Use subtle, desaturated images for login/hero backgrounds to maintain a professional, administrative feel. Do not overuse images inside the dashboard.
media.photo_uploads: UI must clearly show thumbnails of uploaded GPS-encoded photos for water tankers.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Prioritize precision and auditability over generic 'SaaS' aesthetics.
Use a two-font system: Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans/Mono for UI and Data to create an editorial, highly functional look.
Never hide underlying data; explicitly show 'freshness' timestamps or calculation logic (e.g., Avg per-litre cost).
Empty states must be intentional: explain why it's empty and provide a clear CTA.
Mobile views must prioritize 'thumb-zone' ergonomics. Critical actions like 'Add Reading' or 'Upload Photo' should be large bottom-fixed buttons.
DO NOT use a transparent background in headers or overlays.
Never apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do not center-align the main App container. Left-alignment is standard for data-heavy apps.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react sonner clsx tailwind-merge`.
Update `/app/frontend/tailwind.config.js` to extend colors defined in these guidelines and incorporate 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'IBM Plex Sans' into the theme.
Import fonts via Google Fonts and Fontshare in `/app/frontend/src/index.css`.
Create a clean, sidebar-based layout for the Web Admin Console and a Bottom-Tab layout for Mobile users.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts, and use Shadcn for complex interactive components (Tables, Dialogs, Select) adapting them for .jsx extension.
Ensure the 'tabular-nums' utility class is applied to ALL spans/divs displaying currency or meter readings.
Implement Sonner for all success/error toasts (`import { Toaster } from 'sonner'`).
Add `data-testid` to all inputs, buttons, and links. Example: `data-testid='login-submit-button'`.
